# Scenario Seedance 2.5 Music Video

> An Agent Skill that turns a song into a finished music video with Scenario and Seedance 2.5. Five
> steps: song, lyrics, story, frames, video. The supplied master is the soundtrack and is copied, not
> re-encoded.

Requires Python 3.11+, FFmpeg, FFprobe, numpy, and an authenticated Scenario MCP.

## Workflow

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the five step workflow and the non-negotiables.

## Reference

- [references/seedance.md](references/seedance.md): measured Seedance 2.5 contract, costs, and the
  rule that decides whether a shot can open in a given state. In reference-to-video mode frame one is
  anchored to the reference world's base state and no prompt overrides it. Use `image` for first
  frame control.

## Tools

- [scripts/song.py](scripts/song.py): read the master. SHA-256, duration, loudness, tempo, sections,
  cut candidates.
- [scripts/build.py](scripts/build.py): cut and verify in one ffmpeg pass. Conforms clips,
  concatenates, muxes the untouched master, checks coverage, frame count, geometry and audio
  integrity.
- [edit.example.json](edit.example.json): the edit format. A master and a list of shots with start
  times.

## Project

- [README.md](README.md): install, use, verification.
